coffey_math_ph_0505052.S1_bounds: S1(n)=(n/2) log n + O(n), from the displayed rigorous lower and upper bounds.

voros_math_0506326.RH_false: lambda_n has non-tempered oscillations with exponentially growing amplitudes governed by off-line zero poles; equation (18).
voros_math_0506326.rigor_boundary: The paper explicitly notes a rigorous Darboux confirmation of the RH-false exponential alternative.

lagarias_math_0404394.cross_check: If RH fails for the relevant L-function, the incomplete Li/finite-place term is sometimes exponentially large in n; used only as an independent primary-source structural cross-check, not as the sole proof.

structural_coordinates.exact_remainder_relation: lambda_n - S_Lambda(n) = S_gamma(n)+S1(n)+1-(n/2)(gamma+log(pi)+2 log 2) = (n/2)log n + O(n).
structural_coordinates.root_false_mode: off-critical zeros force exponentially growing two-sign oscillations in lambda_n.
structural_coordinates.first_discriminator: Test whether any polynomial-growth certificate |S_Lambda(n)|<=C n^A could be a strictly weaker intermediate obligation.
